title: Email
summary: Email client with left sidebar showing folder navigation (Inbox, Sent, Draft, Starred, Spam, Trash) with badge counts, and label color chips. Main area shows email list with checkbox selection, sender avatars, subject line, preview text, and timestamp. Compose button at top. Currently showing an email thread view with multiple messages and reply actions.

layout.columns: Left folder sidebar (~20%) with navigation, main email area (~80%) with email list/thread view
